body:
Filemark ships two extensions on INDEPENDENT version tracks: Chrome extension + workspace packages share one version; the VS Code extension has its own. Bump: `task version:bump -- X.Y.Z` sets chrome manifest (apps/chrome-ext/public/manifest.json) + root + apps/chrome-ext/package.json + every packages/*/package.json, but NOT apps/vscode/package.json (bump that with jq separately).
Tags/releases convention (started 2026-08-09; repo had none before): product-prefixed annotated tags `chrome-ext-vX.Y.Z` and `vscode-vX.Y.Z` on the release commit + a `gh release create` per tag (attach the .vsix to the vscode one). Never a bare vX.Y.Z (ambiguous across the two tracks).
Publish commands: Chrome Web Store = root `task cws:publish` (build->zip->upload->submit; CWS_* creds in root .env). Open VSX = `cd apps/vscode && task publish-ovsx` (OVSX_PAT in apps/vscode/.env); published name `khanakia.filemark`. VS Code Marketplace = `cd apps/vscode && task publish` (needs VSCE_PAT); Marketplace name is `khanakia-filemark` (Taskfile temporarily overrides package.json name via a trap) so its id is `khanakia.khanakia-filemark` — DIFFERENT from Open VSX's `khanakia.filemark`. `task package:vsce` builds the .vsix for manual upload (no-PAT fallback). Website = `pnpm --filter @filemark/website-new deploy`; update changelog at apps/website/src/routes/changelog.tsx (RELEASES array) + apps/vscode/CHANGELOG.md each release.
Chrome Web Store GOTCHA: a new upload fails with `ITEM_NOT_UPDATABLE` ("pending review, ready to publish, or deleted status") whenever a prior submission is still in review or an unpublished draft exists. No API override exists — resolve only in the CWS dashboard (publish/discard the pending item or wait), then re-run `task cws:publish`. Not a build problem.
